title: Stroop-Style Interference Tests Between Competing Steering Concepts

original_idea.body: Adapt the Stroop paradigm: measure interference cost between congruent vs incongruent steering-concept pairs. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: mapping which safety concepts conflict when co-steered aids multi-objective deployment, but the link is one step broader (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Congruent/incongruent pair design + interference measurement; clear, beginner-friendly (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (interference matrix), pair construction adds modest effort (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly inference-only interference study on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Stroop-style interference framing for steering concepts appears mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Stroop interference paradigm applied to steering appears underexplored.
